title: Mat
description: 2 captured saves. Source only; format, dependencies, or incomplete code prevent stock BASIC loading.
language: TRS-80 Pocket Computer PC-1 / Sharp PC-121x BASIC
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: MAT matrix calculator — save 1
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. PC-121x header and 104 recorded checksums; ordered lines; terminators; actual F0 EOF; exact length; byte-identical left/right TAP
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. This format or machine is not supported by the shared stock Level II BASIC player.
versions.startupSource:
200 "N"INPUT "ARE YOU SURE(Y/N)";T$
  210 IF T$="Y"LET A(27)=28
  220 END 
  300 "C"INPUT "SIZE(R,C)";N,M
  310 A=A(27):A(A)=M+N/10:A(27)=A+N*M+1
  320 I=1:J=1
  330 PRINT "CALLED ";A
  340 END 
  400 "V"FOR I=1 TO (A(A)-INT (A(A)))*10+.5
  410 PAUSE "ROW ";I
  420 FOR J=1 TO INT (A(A))
  430 INPUT A(A+(I-1)*INT (A(A))+J)
